data.notes: June 2027 is still lightly announced, but Detroit already has a confirmed Juneteenth riverfront hip-hop festival date at Hart Plaza.

events.title: Hart of Detroit Summer Festival
events.summary: The festival’s official site confirms a June 19, 2027 Juneteenth weekend return to Hart Plaza, with the 2027 lineup to be announced later. Prior editions have centered Detroit hip-hop and citywide Black cultural celebration on the riverfront.

events.title: Hart of Detroit Summer Festival 2027
events.summary: The Juneteenth-weekend Hart of Detroit Summer Festival has confirmed June 19, 2027 at Hart Plaza for its third year; the lineup is still pending, but the event is positioned around Detroit’s Black music culture, local artists, vendors, and a large riverfront festival gathering.

events.title: Motor City Pride 2027
events.summary: Michigan’s largest Pride celebration returns to Hart Plaza on June 12–13, 2027, with entertainment stages, parade/community programming, and a strong Detroit LGBTQ+ dance-floor context from recent Riverfront Dance Stage editions.
